text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп goes head-to-head with
Nakayama
Festa to get one step closer
to her dreams' true
meaning and to the
ultimate goal of Eden.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
First off is a spicy showdown, to fuel
those bile
tanks! Next is an abdominal
affray that'd make
anyone hurl—one
hundred sit-ups in a minute!
Somehow,
both contestants pull through.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I look on as the competition ends in a
literal
stand-off to see who can be the
best mall
mannequin. Being scrutinized
by the public
proves too much for
Накаяма Феста, and Gold
Ship claims
victory!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way back, Голд Шипп tells me
about the
voice in her dreams telling her
to go to Eden.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Could her dreams really be connected to
Eden?
Голд Шип takes off in an all-out
sprint, leaving
me lost in thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
